description: Manage the global cron jobs that wake an agent on a schedule. Actions: "list" shows every job with its origin and arm state; "create" schedules a new stored job (name, expression, timezone, prompt, agent_preset, permission_preset, workspace_path required; title, turn_timeout_ms and deliver_channel optional); "update" requires name and at least one patch field; "delete" requires name; "pause" and "resume" require name to stop or re-arm any job of either origin without losing it, and the pause survives a restart; "run_now" requires name to start a job immediately outside its schedule; "note" requires name and notes, and replaces the continuity notes carried into every future run of the job — record what was reported so the next run continues instead of repeating. A job from plugin configuration keeps its definition read-only: change its schedule or prompt by editing that configuration, which takes effect when the host restarts. With requireApproval, create, update, delete, resume, run_now, and note ask for approval, except that a job may replace its own notes during its run.

name.description: Required for create, update, delete, pause, resume, run_now, and note; omit only for list.

expression.description: Required for create; optional patch for update. Cron expression with 5 or 6 fields.

timezone.description: Required for create; optional patch for update. IANA timezone.

prompt.description: Required for create; optional patch for update. Prompt for every fire.

agent_preset.description: Required for create; optional patch for update.

permission_preset.description: Required for create; optional patch for update.

workspace_path.description: Required for create; optional patch for update. Absolute path.

title.description: Optional for create and update. Session title override.

turn_timeout_ms.description: Optional for create and update. Per-run timeout in milliseconds, at least 1000; omit to use plugin turnTimeoutMs.

deliver_channel.description: Optional for create and update. Channel id for final text; an empty string removes delivery.

notes.description: Required for note. Full replacement continuity notes; use an empty string to clear.
